rationale: Correct Wecom's upstream ownership chain without treating GIC's 46.74% interest in Searchlight Fiber Alliance as a direct company-level percentage. Searchlight controls Wecom through the SFA, WCM Topco and WCM Holdco chain. GIC and ADIA hold insulated nonvoting interests in SFA, while Simple Broadband II and the founders retain minority Topco interests. Preserve one Wecom operating-company boundary and keep the exact GIC and ADIA entry dates as not publicly disclosed.

companyFieldUpdates.description: Wecom Fiber is the operating brand of Wecom LLC, an Arizona-based fiber broadband platform serving residential, business and community customers across eight Arizona counties and parts of Nevada. Searchlight Capital Partners controls the company through Searchlight Fiber Alliance, WCM Topco and WCM Holdco. GIC and Abu Dhabi Investment Authority hold insulated nonvoting interests in Searchlight Fiber Alliance rather than direct 46.74% stakes in Wecom; the FCC calculated each chain at 36.38% indirect Holdco equity. Simple Broadband II and the founders retain minority Topco interests. Public programs and private matching capital support a planned build to more than 66,000 premises, but customer and route-mile totals are not publicly disclosed. No later sale or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 29, 2026.
